player_prompt.intro:
Woezɔe kple Frozen Lake!

'P' wɔ grid la me nye aƒeme.
Grid symbols:
  ' ' = Gleti ƒe afɔ (dzɔdzɔe le)
  'H' = Kɔƒu (dzɔdzɔe me, aleke!
  'G' = Ɖoƒe (kpɔ dzɔdzɔe le, aʋa!
  'P' = Aƒeme si nyuie

Dɔwɔwɔ siwo sɔ kpe: dzɔdzɔe dzi, gɔme, gbɔ, ɖɔɖɔ (alo w, a, s, d)
Ŋlɔ dzɔdzɔe me: [up], [down], [left], [right] alo [w], [a], [s], [d]

Ɖoƒe: Dzɔdzɔe tso afɔ (dzɔdzɔe dzi) yi ɖoƒe (gbɔme ɖɔɖɔ) kple gleti ƒe afɔ me kɔƒuwo me!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dɔwɔwɔ si meƒo. Ŋlɔ dzɔdzɔe me: [up], [down], [left], [right] alo [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Dɔwɔ si womenya o '{action}'. Zã dzi, anyime, miame, ɖusime alo w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Eŋu wo dze kpɔ {action} ame ga asi wɔ!

game_action.moved: Eŋu wo dze {action} dzi kpɔ evelia ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Akpe na wò! Èɖo taɖodzinu la gbɔ.
outcome.fell_in_hole: Ège ɖe do me! Fefe nu yi. Wòe wu mɔa ƒe {pct}% ɖo ta taɖodzinu gbɔ.
outcome.turn_limit: Miɖo miaƒe mɔ ƒe liƒo dzi! Fefe nu yi. Miewu mɔzɔzɔ si ɖo ta taɖodzinu la me {pct} % nu.
